prologue.name: Kampung Awal
prologue.intro: A small coastal village where the storyteller's satchel has been kept for years. Your grandmother's notebook is waiting to be filled.

sumatra.name: Sumatra
sumatra.tagline: Highlands, long houses and the sound of the saluang
sumatra.intro: Volcanic highlands, rainforest rivers and villages of carved timber. The island is home to many communities - Minangkabau, Batak, Aceh, Lampung, Palembang and many more - each with their own houses, cloths and songs.

java.name: Java
java.tagline: Rice terraces, gamelan and temple stone
java.intro: Terraced rice fields, market towns and the quiet bronze voices of the gamelan. Javanese, Sundanese, Betawi and Tengger communities share this island with nine-hundred-year-old temples.

kalimantan.name: Kalimantan
kalimantan.intro: Great rivers cut through the rainforest, and villages sit on stilts above the water. Dayak communities, Banjar river towns and coastal Malay villages each keep their own crafts and stories.

sulawesi.name: Sulawesi
sulawesi.intro: A shapeshifting island of mountains and deep bays. Toraja highlands, Bugis and Makassar harbours, Minahasa gardens and Bajo stilt villages all face the sea in their own way.

papua.name: Papua
papua.tagline: Mountains, rivers and a thousand languages
papua.intro: Highland valleys ringed by mountains, wide rivers and coastal villages. Papua is home to hundreds of communities - Dani, Asmat, Sentani, Biak and many others - each with their own language and traditions.

chapters.title: Awal Perjalanan
chapters.subtitle: The notebook opens
chapters.text: Your grandmother left one request: travel, and write down what people tell you.

chapters.title: Jejak Sumatra
chapters.subtitle: Highlands and rivers
chapters.text: The highland road leads to carved houses and a festival that must not be late.

chapters.title: Tanah Jawa
chapters.subtitle: Bronze and rice
chapters.text: In the shadow of the temples, an old melody waits to be played again.

chapters.title: Di Antara Sungai dan Hutan
chapters.subtitle: Down the great river
chapters.text: The river keeps what it takes - unless someone knows how to read it.

chapters.title: Tanah yang Menghadap Laut
chapters.subtitle: Sails and saddle roofs
chapters.text: Harbour towns and hill villages trade more than goods: they trade stories.

chapters.title: Timur Nusantara
chapters.subtitle: Mountain and coast
chapters.text: To the east, the notebook finds the oldest stories of all.

chapters.title: Jejak yang Menyatukan
chapters.subtitle: One archipelago
chapters.text: Every page written so far points to the same thing: none of it is separate.
